arguments.sql:
WITH japanese_printings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.name AS japanese_name, c.type AS english_type,
           c.uuid, c.watermark
    FROM main.cards AS c
    JOIN main.foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE f.language = 'Japanese'
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT japanese_name, english_type
    FROM japanese_printings
    WHERE watermark = 'boros'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS japanese_printings_for_eligible_cards,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.uuid) AS distinct_printing_uuids,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN p.watermark = 'boros' THEN 1 END) AS boros_printings,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN p.japanese_name IS NULL OR p.english_type IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_identity,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.watermark IS NOT 'boros' THEN r.id END) AS ruling_entries_on_other_printings
FROM japanese_printings AS p
JOIN eligible AS e ON e.japanese_name IS p.japanese_name
                  AND e.english_type IS p.english_type
LEFT JOIN main.rulings AS r ON r.uuid = p.uuid

arguments.sql:
WITH japanese_printings AS (
    SELECT f.name AS japanese_name,
           c.type AS english_type,
           c.uuid,
           MAX(c.watermark IS 'boros') AS has_boros_watermark
    FROM main.cards AS c
    JOIN main.foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE f.language = 'Japanese'
    GROUP BY f.name, c.type, c.uuid
)
SELECT p.japanese_name,
       p.english_type,
       COUNT(r.id) AS total_rulings
FROM japanese_printings AS p
LEFT JOIN main.rulings AS r ON r.uuid = p.uuid
GROUP BY p.japanese_name, p.english_type
HAVING MAX(p.has_boros_watermark) = 1
ORDER BY p.japanese_name, p.english_type
